answer: In PoA, reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, requiring sustained, honestly verified service rather than instant inheritance. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity assign freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted edges, even a yarrow-themed, spiral-linked, violet-named cluster cannot amplify its influence or satisfy consensus thresholds.
